verdict.rationale: The product's own documentation describes a few one-action-to-many-records behaviors: a single Company Profile update automatically propagates to company records across all jurisdictions and compliance areas, and annual reports are filed automatically in every state as they come due. Neither is a general user-driven bulk operation; the API evidence (rate limits, idempotency keys, write capabilities granted per account) offers building blocks, not batch endpoints. Missing for 10: user-selectable multi-item bulk actions (bulk edit/update/delete), documented batch API endpoints, bulk operations reachable by agents or programs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
